subject: ddl: Remove explicit exclude for "engine" notIn "tiflash" (#58637)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: `(*Bundle).Tidy()` stops auto-adding `-engine=tiflash` to every placement rule (pkg/ddl/placement/bundle.go); this avoids PD store-candidate expansion when `engine` constraints are present (PD `notIn` matches missing labels and would include other engines like `tiflash_compute`). No other DDL/metadata state-machine logic changed, and later history to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up fix related to this behavior.
